module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-and-add multiplier: a 3-state FSM starts on s, iterates 16 cycles adding shifted multiplicand into an accumulator, then pulses done.

anchors.name: m
anchors.why: Idle/run/finish state register sequencing load, 16 add-shift iterations and done pulse.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start input; in idle loads operands, clears accumulator and enters run state.

anchors.name: p
anchors.why: 32-bit product output, direct copy of the accumulator register.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: One-cycle done pulse in finish state marking product valid.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Multiplicand operand loaded into shift register x on start.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Multiplier operand loaded into shift register y on start.

anchors.name: bz
anchors.why: Busy level output, high while FSM is in run state.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Multiplicand register shifted left each iteration, added into accumulator.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Multiplier register shifted right; its LSB selects whether x is added.

anchors.name: k
anchors.why: Iteration counter incremented each run cycle; reaching 16 ends multiplication.

anchors.name: t
anchors.why: Adder result acc+x or acc selected by y[0], written to accumulator.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Terminal-count flag k==16 moving FSM from run to finish.

groups.name: control_fsm
groups.description: Idle/run/finish FSM handling start, busy indication and done pulse.

groups.name: iteration_counter
groups.description: Counts 16 add-shift iterations and flags completion.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand shift registers, conditional adder and accumulator producing the product.
